title: Treat stored data as input
summary: A database record can have a shape your UI does not expect.
introduction: A database record can have a shape your UI does not expect. Your task: Test a record whose pages field is text.

blocks.text: A database record can have a shape your UI does not expect. Check values before using them, even when a type annotation looks reassuring.

Use the Firebase Emulator Suite with the demo-reading-club project and Firestore on port 8080. Install the firebase JavaScript SDK in a local browser project. Run each full snippet on a fresh page. Keep the sample rules local.

blocks.title: Treat stored data as input

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: The guard checks both required fields and their runtime types.
Only a record that passes those checks is used to build the displayed book label.

blocks.text: The first line describes the book, and the second gives an incomplete-data message.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A TypeScript type does not check network data at runtime by itself. Validate important fields.
